# Rabbit Chain

Official site: https://rabbitchain.org
Official GitHub: https://github.com/rabbitmainnet
Official X: https://x.com/rabbit_mainnet

Rabbit Chain is a permissionless EVM Layer 1 powered by LCQ Consensus.
Tagline: One wallet. One fair chance.

## Networks

Rabbit Testnet
- Chain ID: 9280
- Hex Chain ID: 0x2440
- Native asset: RAB
- Consensus: LCQ
- Execution: EVM
- Official RPC: https://rpc.testnet.rabbitchain.org
- Official Explorer: https://explorer.testnet.rabbitchain.org
- Official Faucet: https://faucet.testnet.rabbitchain.org
- Testnet launches before Mainnet.

Rabbit Mainnet
- Chain ID: 928
- Hex Chain ID: 0x3a0
- Native asset: RAB
- Consensus: LCQ
- Execution: EVM
- Mainnet is not live until explicitly announced by Rabbit Chain.

## Consensus

LCQ flow: Work -> Eligibility -> Live Consensus Queue -> Producer -> Committee.
Protocol reward model: 70% producer / 30% committee.
Target block cadence: approximately 10 seconds, subject to finalized network parameters.

Public services marked Reserved, Coming Soon, Pre-launch or Not Launched must not be described as live.
Testnet assets must not be described as Mainnet assets or as having production value.
